description: Full segment leaderboards (and filters), segment effort analysis and comparison, matched runs, and the web route builder moved to subscribers only; free users keep the top-10 leaderboard view. Segment leaderboard API endpoint removed for all third-party apps.
notes: Effective immediately on the publication date; API changes live 10 AM Pacific. Strava also consolidated its tiered plans into a single subscription.

description: Reports of Strava subscription price increases surfaced (UK monthly 6.99 to 8.99 GBP; US new-subscriber pricing about 79 USD/year and 12.99 USD/month per the source's own test). Strava published no price list and said changes vary by region and platform.
notes: Date is first public reporting, not a Strava announcement; rollout was staggered (UK reportedly earlier in late 2022) and users were notified individually before renewal. Renewal prices applied to renewals on or after 2023-02-02; subscribers who joined after 2022-11-23 reportedly exempt for now. Strava later apologized for the lack of transparency; exact apology date not yet verified.

description: Garmin Connect+ premium plan announced at 6.99 USD/month or 69.99 USD/year with a 30-day trial: Active Intelligence insights, Performance Dashboard, Live Activity, training guidance, expanded LiveTrack, badge challenges. Garmin states all existing Connect features remain free.
notes: First time Garmin charged for app features; independent walkthrough at https://dcrainmaker.com/2025/03/garmin-connect-plus-subscription-walkthrough.html (published 2025-03-27).

description: AllTrails Peak launched at 79.99 USD/year above the existing Plus tier (35.99 USD/year); Peak-only features include custom routes, detailed trail conditions, and community heatmaps; Outdoor Lens added later in summer.
notes: Launch date taken from a press review stating 'launches today, 12 May 2025'; some features arrived in a June app update (phased rollout). Official AllTrails announcement URL still to be located. A third-party pricing site claims a 2024 launch and conflicts with editorial sources.

description: Surfline Premium (US) annual price raised from 99 USD to 119.99 USD (about 21%); new Premium with Ads tier at 69.99 USD/year; Premium+ at 149.99 USD/year now shareable with two other accounts.
notes: Effective date per Surfline support article (last updated 2025-05-05); members were emailed shortly before their renewal, so exposure dates vary by user. Wayback copy: http://web.archive.org/web/20260623223550/https://support.surfline.com/hc/en-us/articles/35208905809051-US-Price-Tier-Updates. Prior increase was July 2018 (95.88 USD for new subscribers, existing 69.99 USD rate grandfathered one year), outside the likely review window and not recorded as a row because the exact day is unsourced.
